defect: Unresolved Call drops current_target and repeats super_terminator; non-Item instances can escape classification. Review the B1 candidate independently against TASK-KANI3300-B1.md.
applicability: Only upstream uninitialized-memory call handling and its regression controls. No memory-model extensions, builds, dispatch, or Kani publication.
invariants: Exactly one super_terminator per Call; retain entry loads and collected operand operations on resolution error.
Every instance kind has an explicit supported or Unsupported policy.
One pass owns fn-pointer/virtual diagnostics regardless of delayed-UB seeds; do not weaken checks.
controls: Empty entry block with union argument loads, initialized/partial controls; pending operand checks at unresolved Call.
FnPtr, erased/wrapped pointer, virtual, global/escaped, shim, direct positive; each with and without added delayed-UB seed.
Audit Rust warning hazards under -D warnings; local compilation is forbidden.
known_limitations: No local cargo/rustc/Kani/CBMC, builds, Actions, Cloud, raw logs/archives, credentials, or network writes. Compiler execution and measured results are reserved to coordinator fork CI.
Source inspection and goldens are expectations, not measured false SUCCESS or proof credit.
